Hi Laura / Jonas —

Attached is the consolidated OKR Launch Playbook (v1) and the proposed rollout timeline for Q2. This is largely based on the working doc we discussed last week; I've pulled out the exec asks and the go/no-go gate checklist so signoff is straightforward.

Key asks:
- Laura: confirm owner roll call and any resource constraints by EOD tomorrow.
- Jonas: please review the gating criteria under section 3 (SLOs & fallback policies) — we need your approval or redlines.
- I'll coordinate a 30-minute signoff slot once we have both approvals.

Attachments: OKR_Launch_Playbook_v1.pdf, Q2_Rollout_Timeline.xlsx

Thanks,

Tessa —

Thanks for the tidy playbook. Quick notes inline below (copied to the PDF comments as well):

- Ownership: I'll take Owner for Objective 1 (Launch readiness) but will delegate Task 1.3 (docs & runbooks) to Priya — she'll be the day-to-day.
- Headcount: hiring for 1 infra SRE is still open; that could impact the mitigation window in section 3.2. I'll flag with Eng recruiting today.
- Exec ask: can we shorten the signoff doc to a one-page checklist for the VP review? Execs prefer less than 5 bullets.

Otherwise looks good. I can be available for the 30-minute signoff Tues/Wed after 2pm PT.

Laura Bennett
Dir, Product Ops
Redwood Inference

Tessa / Laura —

Reviewed section 3 (SLOs & fallback). A couple of technical comments:
- Fallback policy 1: the active model fallback needs an explicit latency SLA (we should call out 150ms p50 and 400ms p95 for the interim).
- KV cache plan: please add required memory estimates for the 99th percentile session to the timeline (I added a row in the spreadsheet).

I'm comfortable approving the OKRs pending those two small changes. If you can update by EOD tomorrow I'll sign off.

Jonas Weber
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
